_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the Connected Planning Sales Foundations journey. Five content blocks covering the universal sales-foundation domains — Connected Planning narrative deep-dive, generic discovery + qualification, value-messaging fundamentals, competitive landscape overview, universal objection handling. Per-application specifics are added in per-app Sales journeys (IFP Sales, FCR Sales, etc.).
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: seller has internalized the Connected Planning narrative, can run a generic Anaplan discovery and qualification conversation, can articulate value at executive and practitioner levels, knows the high-level competitive landscape, and has practiced top universal objections. Stage 3 is the AI-graded mock pitch + Sales Foundations certification.

tasks.title: Connected Planning Narrative (deep-dive)
tasks.description: Webcast deepening the Connected Planning narrative beyond the Anaplan Overview intro — executive value frame, ROI conversation patterns, the multi-application strategic-deal story (how IFP + FCR + AI compose into a Connected Planning enterprise narrative).

tasks.title: Discovery & Qualification Foundations
tasks.description: Guide covering the universal Anaplan discovery question library (pain signals, decision criteria, planning maturity indicators) and qualification framework (MEDDPICC or partner equivalent applied to Anaplan opportunities). Per-app discovery layers on top in per-app Sales journeys.

tasks.title: Value-Messaging Fundamentals
tasks.description: Recording covering value-pitch construction craft — story arcs, executive-vs-practitioner messaging, business-outcome anchors, and how to weave proof points and references into a tailored pitch. The structural approach every per-app value pitch builds on.

tasks.title: Competitive Landscape Overview
tasks.description: Walkthrough of the major competitive sets sellers encounter — enterprise planning suites (Workday Adaptive, Pigment, OneStream, etc.), Excel/Hyperion/legacy installs, point solutions (single-purpose tools), and GenAI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot — emerging objection). High-level positioning only; per-app technical battlecards in per-app journeys.

tasks.title: Universal Objection Handling
tasks.description: Top 5-7 universal objections every Anaplan seller faces, with canonical responses: 'we already have this in Excel/Hyperion/Workday', 'we'll just use ChatGPT', 'platform vs point solution', 'TCO concerns', 'change management', 'integration concerns'. The response patterns sellers reach for repeatedly.
